signal.score: second phase gap minus first phase gap

controls.center_migration: sign of second-block center minus first-block center

development_gates: at least four trades per week
ending cash above passive price-only SPY
positive after one extra cent at entry and exit
positive after five additional entry minutes
positive after removing ten best sessions
fixed-notional P&L above each frozen control
holdout_gates: ending cash above passive price-only SPY
positive after one extra cent each fill
positive after five additional entry minutes
positive after removing five best sessions
fixed-notional P&L above each frozen control
positive EQUS execution with unchanged ARCA signal
prohibited_changes: drop a side, year, weekday, month, or volatility state
combine with previous candidates based on P&L
open holdout after any development failure
